correctness.rationale: Inspected actual left derivative diag(2,1,…,1) and right derivative signed cyclic shift with −2 on wrap. For n-word with k right visits their product is signed monomial, underlying permutation +k mod M. Cycle length ℓ=M/gcd(k,M), each cycle wrap sign (−1)^{k/g}, weight magnitude 2^{a_h}, Σa_h=n; hence char polynomial ∏(λ^ℓ−(−1)^{k/g}2^{a_h}). If ℓ=1 all eigenvalues are real; if ℓ≥3 nonreal roots exist; if ℓ=2 then gcd(k/g,ℓ)=1 makes k/g odd, so λ²+2^{a_h} gives nonreal pair. Primary source establishes bijection of all n-words with k≥1 and nontrivial iterate-fixed points. Count via ∑_{M|j}binom(n,j)−1, complement, and roots-of-unity filter gives limiting real fraction 1/M and sharp error ≤(M−1)/M(2cos π/M)^n. Independently rederived exact symbolic matrices and polynomials for 600 nontrivial words across M=2…6, n=1…6, all consistent; general proof analytic and relies explicitly on primary coding theorem.
residual_risks: Claims outside exact stated normalization, field, and domain have not been proved.
